config.title: One Week in Berlin - FAQ
config.subtitle: Which weekday each part of a 7-day Berlin plan needs: Monday closures, Sunday shops, the Wednesday concert, the dome dates and the day trips.

items.q: Is one week in Berlin too long?
items.a: No. Seven days give you the centre, Museum Island, the Wall, City West, a Sunday at the **Mauerpark** and one or two day trips without rushing. The catch is that some sights close on set weekdays, so the order of the days matters more than the number.

items.q: What is closed in Berlin on Mondays?
items.a: Every museum on **Museum Island**, the **Gemäldegalerie**, the **Neue Nationalgalerie**, **Sanssouci Palace** in Potsdam and **Charlottenburg Palace**. The outdoor Berlin Wall Memorial on Bernauer Straße, the Sachsenhausen memorial and the Reichstag dome are open.

items.q: Which day is best for Museum Island?
items.a: **Thursday**, because the Bode-Museum stays open until 20:00. Any day from Tuesday to Sunday works; Monday never does. Pick two museums, for example the **Neues Museum** and the **Alte Nationalgalerie**, both open 10:00 to 18:00.

items.q: When is the free lunch concert at the Berlin Philharmonie?
items.a: Every **Wednesday at 13:00** from September to June. Entry is free with a chip handed out at the door, first come, first served, so arrive around 12:15.

items.q: Can I visit the Reichstag dome in October 2026?
items.a: Yes, except from **19 to 30 October 2026**, when the Bundestag closes the dome for cleaning; the roof terrace stays open. Registration in advance with ID is required, and the last entry is at 21:45.

items.q: What are the best day trips for a week in Berlin?
items.a: **Potsdam** for the palaces of Sanssouci, which open Tuesday to Sunday, and the **Sachsenhausen** memorial in Oranienburg, which is free and open every day, 08:30 to 16:30 from 27 October. Keep the two trips on separate days with a day in the centre between them.

items.q: Where should I spend Sunday in Berlin?
items.a: At the **Mauerpark flea market** in Prenzlauer Berg, open 10:00 to 18:00. Shops are closed on Sundays, so keep Kurfürstendamm and KaDeWe for a weekday. The Berliner Dom opens at 12:00 on Sundays because of the morning service.
